title: Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas?
body: Over 100 NLP researchers judged LLM-generated ideas more novel than their own - but no more feasible.

title: Automating Hypothesis Generation with AI
body: A causal graph from 43,312 psychology papers matched doctoral students on novelty; the LLM alone did not.

title: Generative Grounded Theory with AI
body: A seven-step framework for inductive theory building, one prompt per stage - AI as bounded co-theorist.
